content: {"episode_id":"ep-05044","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, for which prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to the syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
